summary: AMG ADVISORY AS (org. no. 938 271 062) is a private limited company (AS) based in Bergen, in the Brønnøysund registers since 2026-08-17. It is active with no bankruptcy or liquidation registered. Its main activity is NACE 70.200 (Bedriftsrådgivning og annen administrativ rådgivning); it has 0 registered employees. Board chair: Anders Brian Peter Godfrey.
